$description: Design-system spacing scale. pokemon-tool's web app has never had a custom spacing token layer — it uses Tailwind's default 4px-based scale directly. This formalizes the app's actual most-frequently-used steps (by usage count across app/components/lib) as named brand tokens, so iOS has an explicit, non-guessed spacing vocabulary to match — the same extraction discipline used for radius/status. Not a redesign: these values already are the shipping spacing rhythm.

md.$description: Default gap — the single most common spacing value in the app.
